company.name: Tandem
company.description: A language exchange app. Learners chat with native speakers and buy lesson packs inside the app, with local payment methods in each country.

title: Tandem: purchases are down
brief: Conversion, the share of daily active users who buy a lesson pack, fell 12% in the last 7 days compared with the week before. Revenue is behind plan for the quarter and finance wants to know if this is temporary. Find the cause, and say how sure you are.

rootCause.summary: The local payment provider in Brazil is failing most transactions.
rootCause.explanation: Conversion collapsed in Brazil on every platform and app version at once, overnight, while usage in Brazil stayed normal. People still want to buy; their payments fail. Nothing in our product changed that day.
rootCause.idealAction: Escalate to the payment provider, add a fallback payment method for Brazil, and tell affected users that they were not charged.
idealPath: Break down by country: Brazil collapses, other countries are flat
Within Brazil, break down by platform: every platform drops together
Check DAU in Brazil: usage is normal, so demand is not the issue

falseLeads.explanation: The checkout copy experiment lowers web conversion by a few percent, which is worth watching but far too small to explain the overall drop.
The UK bank holiday lowers activity for a weekend. It moves usage, not the share of users who buy.

actionOptions.label: Escalate to the Brazilian payment provider and add a fallback payment method
Stop the web checkout copy experiment
Launch a discount for users in Brazil
Wait for the UK bank holiday effect to pass
